slot.brief: Rank or pick the odd one out among given amines in aqueous basicity (aliphatic vs aniline vs ammonia type comparison); purely conceptual, no pKa values.

stem: Which of the following is the weakest base in aqueous solution?

verdicts.working: Aniline’s nitrogen lone pair is delocalized into the benzene ring, making it less available to accept a proton. It is therefore a weaker base than ammonia and the aliphatic amines.

working:
In aniline, the nitrogen lone pair is delocalised into the benzene ring, reducing its availability for protonation.
The lone pairs in ammonia and the aliphatic amines are not delocalised into an aromatic ring.
Thus, aniline is the weakest base in aqueous solution.
